product_overview: NADI adalah prototipe interaktif wellness monitoring untuk lansia yang menampilkan pola keseharian dan memberi tahu keluarga saat ada perubahan dari biasanya. Aplikasi ini berfokus pada pengalaman keluarga dan lansia dalam mode demo, dengan mode sensor langsung sebagai opsi tambahan.
core_goals: Melihat ringkasan kondisi harian lansia dari dashboard utama
Meninjau riwayat pola tidur, aktivitas, dan bangun malam selama 7 hari
Menerima dan menindaklanjuti notifikasi ketika ada pola yang perlu dicek
Menghubungi lansia atau layanan darurat dari detail alert
Mengatur urutan kontak keluarga, jeda pemantauan, dan sumber data aplikasi

routes.description: Single-page app. There is no URL routing; screens are switched with the bottom navigation bar (Beranda, Riwayat, Notifikasi, Pengaturan) and in-app state. The UI is in Bahasa Indonesia and rendered inside a phone-sized frame (max width 430px). All data is static demo data with a fixed "now" of 24 Sep 2026 09:20 WIB, so the story is identical on every load. State resets on page reload.

features.name: Bottom navigation
features.description: Four tabs switch the family app screens; the active tab is highlighted. Notifikasi shows a count badge of unanswered (status "Baru") alerts when there are any.
user_interactions: Click "Beranda" to show the dashboard
Click "Riwayat" to show the 7-day history
Click "Notifikasi" to show the alert list
Click "Pengaturan" to show settings
See a number badge on "Notifikasi" after a new unanswered alert is created

features.name: Dashboard (Beranda)
features.description: Shows elder profile header ("Ibu Sri Wahyuni", "Dipantau sejak 2 Maret 2026"), a status card ("Status saat ini" with Normal / Waspada / Darurat), a "Ringkasan hari ini" section with three metric cards (Tidur semalam 7,1 jam; Waktu aktif hari ini 47 %; Terbangun malam 1 kali) each compared with "Pola biasanya", the last-activity line, a disclaimer, and a demo-only "Simulasikan anomali" button. Initially the status is "Normal". When a new Waspada/Darurat alert exists, the status card shows that level and a "Lihat & tindak lanjuti" button that opens the alert detail.
user_interactions: See status card with label "Normal" on first load
See three metric cards with values and comparison text
Click "Simulasikan anomali" to open the elder confirmation screen
Click "Lihat & tindak lanjuti" on a Waspada/Darurat status card to open the alert detail

features.name: Elder confirmation screen (simulated elder phone)
features.description: Opened from "Simulasikan anomali". Full-screen, no bottom nav. Shows the question "Halo Bu Sri, apakah baik-baik saja?", a 20-second countdown ("Sisa N detik") and two large buttons: "Ya, saya baik-baik saja" and "Butuh bantuan". Answering "Ya" shows "Terima kasih, Bu Sri." and adds an Info alert with status Selesai. "Butuh bantuan" or letting the countdown reach 0 shows "Keluarga sedang dihubungi." and adds a Darurat alert with status Baru (dashboard status becomes Darurat and the Notifikasi badge shows 1). A "Kembali ke app keluarga" button (labelled "Fitur demo") returns to the dashboard.
user_interactions: Click "Ya, saya baik-baik saja" and see the thank-you message
Click "Butuh bantuan" and see "Keluarga sedang dihubungi."
Wait 20 seconds without answering and see "Keluarga sedang dihubungi."
Click "Kembali ke app keluarga" to return to the family dashboard

features.name: Notifications list (Notifikasi)
features.description: Lists all alerts newest first, grouped under "Perlu ditanggapi (n)" (status Baru), "Hari ini", "Kemarin" and "Sebelumnya". Each item shows level badge (Info/Waspada/Darurat), status pill (Baru/Sedang dicek/Selesai), time, and description. Clicking an item opens the alert detail. Initial data has 5 alerts and none with status Baru.
user_interactions: See alerts grouped by "Hari ini", "Kemarin", "Sebelumnya"
Click an alert item to open its detail

features.name: Alert detail and follow-up actions
features.description: Shows "Kembali" back button, level badge, status pill, "Apa yang terdeteksi" with the description, "Dibandingkan pola biasanya" comparing that day's metrics with the usual pattern, and "Tindak lanjut" actions. Waspada + Baru shows "Tandai sudah dicek". Darurat shows "Hubungi Ibu Sri Wahyuni" (opens a simulated call modal with "Memanggil…" and "Akhiri panggilan") and "Hubungi layanan darurat" (opens a confirmation dialog "Hubungi layanan darurat (112)?" with "Ya, hubungi 112" and "Batal"; confirming opens the simulated call modal). After any action the alert status changes from Baru to "Sedang dicek" and the note "Respons tercatat" appears. Already handled alerts show "Notifikasi ini sudah ditanggapi...".
user_interactions: Click "Kembali" to return to the previous list
Click "Hubungi Ibu Sri Wahyuni" and see the simulated call modal, then click "Akhiri panggilan"
Click "Hubungi layanan darurat", then "Batal" to cancel the confirmation dialog
Click "Hubungi layanan darurat", then "Ya, hubungi 112" to open the simulated call
Press Escape to close the dialog or modal
See "Respons tercatat" after taking an action

features.name: History (Riwayat)
features.description: 7-day history with a WAI-ARIA tablist for metrics ("Durasi tidur", "Waktu aktif", "Bangun malam"), a Recharts bar chart, a row of day buttons (aria-pressed) below the chart, and a day-detail card for the selected day. Days far from the usual pattern (22 Sep) are marked with "!" and the legend "Berbeda jauh dari biasanya". The detail card lists NADI alerts for that day ("Catatan NADI di hari ini") which can be opened.
user_interactions: Click the "Waktu aktif" or "Bangun malam" tab to switch metric
Use arrow keys / Home / End to move between metric tabs
Click a day button below the chart to select that day and update the detail card
Select 22 September and see "Berbeda jauh dari biasanya"
Click an alert in the day detail to open the alert detail

features.name: Settings (Pengaturan)
features.description: "Kontak keluarga" list in priority order (Rina Wahyuni, Budi Santoso, Bu Darmi) with up/down buttons (aria-label "Naikkan prioritas <nama>" / "Turunkan prioritas <nama>"). "Privasi & Data" section with a "Jeda pemantauan" switch (role=switch); when paused the dashboard shows "Pemantauan dijeda" instead of the Normal status. "Sumber data" radio group: "Demo (data contoh)" or "Sensor langsung (ESP32)". Demo-only "Reset data demo" button restores all state and shows "Data demo sudah dikembalikan ke kondisi awal."
user_interactions: Click "Turunkan prioritas Rina Wahyuni" and see the contact order change
Toggle "Jeda pemantauan" and see the dashboard show "Pemantauan dijeda"
Click "Reset data demo" and see the confirmation message
Select "Sensor langsung (ESP32)" to switch to live sensor mode

features.name: Live sensor mode
features.description: Optional mode. When "Sensor langsung (ESP32)" is selected, the app polls a local Python bridge at http://<hostname>:8765/api/sensor/latest. The dashboard shows only a "Sensor gerak" card plus "Belum tersedia dari sensor ini"; Riwayat and Notifikasi show "Belum tersedia di mode sensor langsung" with a "Beralih ke mode demo" button. Without the bridge running, the card must show "Penghubung sensor tidak terjangkau" (never "Normal").
user_interactions: Select "Sensor langsung (ESP32)" in Pengaturan
See "Penghubung sensor tidak terjangkau" on Beranda when no bridge is running
Open Riwayat and click "Beralih ke mode demo" to return to demo mode

known_limitations.issue: Live sensor mode requires the local Python bridge and ESP32 hardware
known_limitations.impact: In automated tests the bridge is not running, so live mode can only show the "not reachable" state
Reloading the page resets alerts, contacts and settings to the initial demo story
No real phone call is made; the modal only shows "Memanggil…"
